text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P0 - routing-policy-service | elevated 5xx + routing oscillation in eu-west-1. Auto-alerting oncall: @sara. Symptoms: spikes in 5xx, requests bouncing between model-variant v1.3-quant and v1.2-fallback, latency > 1.5s. Triggered 02:34 UTC.

sara: ACK I'm on it. Pulling logs + topology. Paging through. :pager:

aj: I can see the control-plane churn — policies updated repeatedly by the latest schema migration job. There's a chance the removed deprecated field changed the default fallback behavior.

maria: Logs (excerpt):
```
2026-03-15T02:34:12Z routing-policy-update: policy_id=rp-234 action=apply source=deploy-service
2026-03-15T02:34:13Z route-eval: route=eu-west-1 -> model=v1.3-quant fallback->eu-central-1
2026-03-15T02:34:13Z route-eval: route=eu-central-1 -> model=v1.2-fallback fallback->eu-west-1
2026-03-15T02:34:14Z route-eval: route=eu-west-1 -> model=v1.3-quant fallback->eu-central-1
```
That's literally a loop.

kevin: If fallback policy is choosing region_priority and older variant by default we get ping-pong. We should stop automatic fallback to break the oscillation.

sara: Agreed. Mitigation proposal: 1) disable smart fallback globally 2) pin traffic to v2-stable in eu-west-1 3) rollback the schema migration that removed the deprecated default. Any objections?

aj: +1. I can prepare the rollback diff. Quick note: the removed field was `legacy_default_variant`. When absent, the runtime previously honored `policy.default_variant`, now it falls back to `region_priority` which picks older variants in other regions.

maria: I'll run the disable command now.

maria: ```bash
# disable smart fallback to stop cross-region failovers
redwoodctl routing set --service routing-policy-service --set fallback.enabled=false --reason "incident 2008001234"
```

deploy-bot: Command accepted. Executing change across control-plane. Change ID: ch-9987.

incident-bot: Update: fallback.enabled=false rolled out to 3/3 control-plane clusters in eu-west-1/eu-central-1/us-east-1.

kevin: Monitoring metrics -> error rate dropped 45% in last 3 minutes. Latency is trending down. Good sign.

aj: Here's the minimal rollback patch I recommend (applied to the schema migration job):
```diff
-  "remove": ["/policy/legacy_default_variant"]
+  "remove": []
+  "add": {"/policy/legacy_default_variant": "v2-stable"}
```
When the field is absent the runtime picks an undesirable default. Adding it back preserves previous behavior.

sara: maria, can you roll that migration back? We want to reinstate `legacy_default_variant` set to `v2-stable`. After rollback we'll re-enable controlled fallback if needed.

maria: Rolling back migration job id=mg-20260314-7 now. Command:
```
redwoodctl migrations rollback --id mg-20260314-7 --confirm
```

maria: Rollback completed. Config changed: `legacy_default_variant: v2-stable` present again.

incident-bot: Observability update: route-eval churn reduced to near-baseline; no more cross-region flip-flops observed for 5+ minutes.

kevin: Now pin production traffic to v2-stable in eu-west-1 just to be safe while we watch.

maria: Executing traffic pin:
```
redwoodctl routing pin --region eu-west-1 --model v2-stable --weight 100 --reason "incident 2008001234 temporary pin"
```

deploy-bot: Routing pin accepted. ch-9991.

aj: Quick checks: run a small canary load against v2-stable for 10 minutes to confirm no regression. I'll kick that off.

aj: Canary run shows stable latency and low error rate. Looks good.

tiffany: CS note: we saw customer-facing errors for ~6 customers for a 7-12 minute window, mostly transient 5xx. No escalations yet, CS is prepping a proactive note to impacted accounts.

sara: Handoff: I'm going to remove myself from active paging in 20m. aj please take post-incident follow-up (root cause writeup + remediation to prevent schema migrations removing that field in future).

aj: Taking it. Action items: 1) postmortem draft 2) add CI validation to fail migration when `legacy_default_variant` is removed without explicit override 3) add a temporary alert rule for rapid cross-region route-eval flips.

kevin: Recommend also a small change: when fallback.enabled=false we should ensure clear default variant is set to avoid 429/unknown states. I'll open a ticket.

incident-bot: INCIDENT-2008001234 status: RESOLVED -> mitigated. Pager closed. Duration ~12 minutes. Root cause preliminary: schema migration removed `legacy_default_variant` causing fallback default to pick older regional variants, leading to oscillation.

sara: Thanks team. Good coordination. I'll join the postmortem doc review later today. :thumbsup:

aj: I'll own the follow-ups. Adding timeline and configs to the postmortem.

maria: Leaving a note in the runbook: when you see cross-region route flip-flop -> disable fallback first, then pin safe variant, then rollback schema if needed.

incident-bot: Close log attached to incident ticket IT-3421.
